source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
[Covert Stealth Team](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.gaunts-ghosts.covert-stealth-team) on Gaunt's Ghosts is rewritten. As your opponent's turn ends, you may use it if it is **unengaged**. If you do:

- place the unit in **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**
- it has **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)** until your next [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) starts
- it is required to make an **[Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)** during your next [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), even in your first turn

typedMechanics.grantExpires: start of next own Shooting phase
